title: Federal System Quiz
description: Quiz on Nepal's multi-tier governance, fiscal federalism, and devolution challenges.

questions.question: How many provinces does Nepal have under its federal structure?
questions.explanation: Nepal is constitutionally divided into seven provinces.

questions.question: Which level typically handles local water supply and sanitation services?
questions.explanation: Local governments oversee basic service delivery like water and sanitation.

questions.question: Select the elements commonly associated with fiscal federalism.
questions.explanation: Fiscal federalism concerns revenue assignment, transfers, and grants—not judicial impeachment.

questions.question: True or False: All provinces possess identical fiscal capacity and administrative resources.
questions.explanation: Resource disparities necessitate equalization and capacity-building measures.

questions.question: Which coordination body/tool helps manage overlapping mandates across levels?
questions.explanation: Forums and councils negotiate overlaps in shared functional areas.

questions.question: A key challenge in early devolution phases is:
questions.explanation: Capacity gaps often slow effective devolution and service improvement.

questions.question: Which metric best evaluates local service delivery impact?
questions.explanation: Service impact is assessed via coverage, quality, and citizen satisfaction, not cabinet size.

questions.question: Which characteristic distinguishes Nepal's federal model in its consolidation phase?
questions.explanation: An emphasis on inclusion and adaptive evolution marks Nepal's federal consolidation.
